{
  "output_quality": {"score": 4, "reason": "Charming, competent cartoon drawing of a sloth in a hard hat and vest operating a yellow excavator. Sun, clouds, dirt pile, cones and caution stripe are all recognizable and appealing; nothing appears blank or malformed."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 5, "reason": "Satisfies every hard requirement: standalone SVG, viewBox 0 0 1200 800, no external assets or scripts, valid XML. Includes sky/sun/clouds, ground/dirt pile, cones/caution stripe, full excavator (tracks, rollers, rotating body, cab/window/steering wheel, boom+stick, toothed bucket), and the sloth with hard hat, vest, sleepy face and arm on the wheel."},
  "creativity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Inventive and charming subject: a sleepy sloth running an excavator, with floating \"Zzz\" drifting upward as it nods off. Exhaust puffs and moving clouds add lively, unexpected touches that fit the brief well."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 5, "reason": "Motion genuinely works: across the three frames the boom/stick/bucket completes a digging cycle (bucket rises off the pile then lowers), the sloth's eyes close with rising \"Zzz\", exhaust puffs emit, and clouds translate across the sky."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 5, "reason": "Richly layered scene with 10 gradients, a drop-shadow filter, caution pattern, sun rays, multi-part excavator, toothed bucket with dirt, dirt scatter, cones and detailed sloth features; strong sense of depth."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 5, "reason": "Well-balanced landscape layout: excavator centered, dirt pile and sun on the right, caution stripe anchoring the left. Harmonious warm yellow/blue/brown palette and clear, legible focal point."},
  "summary": "A charming, complete sloth-excavator animation that meets all requirements with a genuine digging cycle, rich detail and polished composition."
}
